problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives with globally L-Lipschitz gradients and f(x₀) − inf f ≤ Δ. Nonconvex objectives are permitted; no convexity, minimizer attainment, or bounded domain is required. L > 0 and Δ > 0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call returns the full vector g(x,ω), with E[g(x,ω)] = ∇f(x). Fresh seeds are IID with common law p; errors may depend on x and coordinates may be dependent. No function values, exact gradients, or reusable sample access are supplied. All Params are public, including dimensions, L, M, σBody, σHead, Δ, ε, δ, and x₀; f, g, p, P, and K are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: Oracle and execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For e(x,ω) = g(x,ω) − ∇f(x), the body block satisfies E[∑ᵢ |eBody,i(x,ω)|] ≤ σBody uniformly in x. Only a first absolute moment is required; no body moment of order greater than one is assumed. σBody ≥ 0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.valid and the body absolute-moment condition in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: The head block satisfies E[∑ⱼ eHead,j(x,ω)²] ≤ σHead² uniformly in x, with integrability explicitly required and σHead ≥ 0. Head errors need not be symmetric. This variance bound does not apply to the body block.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.valid and the head integrability and second-moment conditions in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is ℝ^(bodyDim+headDim) with its Euclidean norm and designated body/head coordinate blocks. Dimensions are nonnegative integers with positive sum; either block may be empty.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Algorithms/HeterogeneousAdam.lean: supplied Point definition; LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: Params and spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each body error coordinate is marginally symmetric: eBody,i(x,ω) and −eBody,i(x,ω) have identical distributions. Neither a density nor joint central symmetry is required. A common measurable, integrable K ≥ 0 satisfies E[K] ≤ M and, almost surely simultaneously for all x,y and body coordinates i, |eBody,i(x,ω) − eBody,i(y,ω)| ≤ K(ω)‖x−y‖, with M ≥ 0. The allowed family is explicitly restricted by α = 9/10, β = 999/1000, damping equal to public δ > 0, positive r₀, and positive body/head step schedules.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: symmetry and K conditions in spec.admissible, spec.valid, and spec.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point X such that ‖∇f(X)‖ is integrable and E[‖∇f(X)‖] ≤ ε, where ε > 0. The norm is Euclidean and unsquared; successful does not require a last iterate or a best-iterate certificate.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over the product of algorithm randomness and the oracle seed-stream law. The extracted budget is a fixed cap on total stochastic-gradient calls, not an expected stopping cost. No high-probability guarantee is required; δ is an algorithm damping parameter.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute; LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.successful and spec.allowedAlgorithm; supplied extracted oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines symmetric first-moment body noise, potentially asymmetric finite-variance head noise, and samplewise Lipschitz body errors with an integrable random modulus. This is an unusual variant of smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization. The classification does not assert novelty; no repository files or Lean proofs were checked.
